text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel's summer training camp began 
once again. Unwilling to let her desire to 
surpass her idol remain just empty words, 
she was fully fired up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Freshly returned from injury, Narita Brian 
was the center of attention. Even her 
warm-up run was overwhelming... Sending 
ripples of awe through the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Sakura Laurel felt that her 
running was a bit different from before.
